split: unchanged split_before_numeric.json, only3 usable dynamic FIT records
future_controls: not used for primary training or rollout; hold current telemetry
label: raw unfiltered asof state at next physical20ms grid; no future state input
normalization: equal-record FIT history/state moments; no development/test
flow: s + tau * state_scale * NN(normalized_state,current_control,causal_history,tau/T_ref); exact initial state
pde: dPhi/dtau - J_state(Phi) f(state,current_control), history fixed as context
pgnn_ref: official build_network GRU3 layers, hidden=51, flattened2601, Dense188 Mish x2; input4/output2 vehicle adaptation, not full original DDM reproduction
pgnn_initialization: head weight zero; bias inverse-sigmoid of calibrated nominal within fixedbounds; no parameter truth

smoke.purpose: engineering finite-gradient and API consistency only, no hyperparameter tuning

missing_metrics: vx and pose predictions not available in lateral task; not imputed
statistics: whole-run holdout same vehicle/campaign, not cross-vehicle independent evidence
derived_speed: published v_cog/beta_cog excluded; direct velocity components with documented rigid transform; thirdrecord inertial residual disclosed
evaluation_export: native MATLAB opaque timeseries require validated server-side export before final test; no heldout parse in engineering stage
